title: Battle for Windhelm
description: The Imperial Legion's final assault on Windhelm. Join General Tullius, fight through the city to the Palace of the Kings, confront Ulfric Stormcloak and Galmar Stone-Fist, and end the Stormcloak rebellion.

base_facts: I am a Legate in the Imperial Legion serving under General Tullius.
I coordinate the Imperial war effort across Skyrim.

QUEST_RECEIVED: I have ordered the Dragonborn to join General Tullius for the final assault on Windhelm.

base_facts: I am the General commanding all Imperial forces in Skyrim.
I am determined to crush the Stormcloak rebellion once and for all.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I demanded Ulfric Stormcloak's surrender in the Palace of the Kings.
I stated that Ulfric's death is the only path to peace.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave the Dragonborn a leveled enchanted sword after Ulfric's death.
I delivered a victory speech to the assembled Imperial soldiers in Windhelm.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I believe Skyrim must be free from the Empire and the Thalmor.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I refused to surrender to General Tullius and fought to the bitter end.
I requested that the Dragonborn be the one to strike me down.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak's right hand and general of the Stormcloak army.
I would rather die fighting than surrender to the Empire.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I stood by Ulfric's side in the Palace of the Kings and fought the Imperial forces.

base_facts: I am a citizen of Windhelm who sympathizes with the Empire's cause.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been installed as the new Jarl of Windhelm after the Imperial victory.
I can grant the privilege of buying property in Windhelm and the title of Thane of Eastmarch.

beats.comment: Player receives orders to join the final assault on Windhelm. Stage 1 fires.
Player fights through Windhelm's streets alongside Imperial soldiers toward the Palace of the Kings.
Player enters the Palace of the Kings and confronts Ulfric and Galmar. Tullius demands surrender; they attack.
Galmar is killed and Ulfric is forced to his knees. Player chooses who delivers the killing blow. Tullius gives a leveled enchanted sword.
Windhelm is captured, Ulfric is dead, the rebellion is destroyed. Tullius gives a victory speech. Brunwulf Free-Winter becomes Jarl. Stage 9000 finishes the quest.
